data.name: Bheru
data.gender_notes: Bheru is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bheru is a Sanskrit name derived from the God Bhairava, the embodiment of fierce power and courage. He is revered as the God of War and is invoked for protection and strength. The name Bheru signifies bravery and fearlessness, inspiring those who bear it to face challenges with determination and valor. The name Bheru carries the meaning “God of War” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bheru usually hope their child will grow to embody god of war and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Bheru belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of War.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bheru total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
